rio_defect: pnpm 12 lockfiles contain separate package-manager and project YAML documents. Rio attempts serde_yaml single-document deserialization and aborts before checks.
reproduction: At pinned head 248fb772a6d6f7ce2492f8549a8d370ec3df9731, install frozen pnpm12.4.1; run rio doctor --format json or rio review --base c869fa1075fc3ce11b38495c5e6044fb97b335d2 --format json --offline --profile profile.yaml.
raw_error: cannot parse pnpm-lock.yaml: deserializing from YAML containing more than one document is not supported
harness_defect: runner reports Rio reviewed different commits than the pinned change rather than the Rio internal_error because it checks missing review.base/head before exposing the fatal error. It creates no verdict skeleton.
workaround_constraints: Changing install flags cannot repair parsing of immutable source lockfile. No tracked lockfile normalization or binary modification permitted. Investigating earlier source controls; no score for this attempt.
